scope: Current Properties string-value editing and Host conditional property receipt, including any/name and the dynamically mapped imported sourceURL property.

basis: AnyNativePropertiesView Save disables only for write authority and byte limit; it does not compare edited text with the original.
AnyNativePropertyValueCodec.text and parse return the original String without trimming or normalization.
prepareSetValue always prepares the one-property patch after validation; apply always dispatches its fenced POST after authority checks.

intendedContract.evidenceLevel: Inferred from exact current caller, codec, canonical-identity helper, receipt comments and existing tests; no new Native promise or contract change.
intendedContract.strings: Preserve the supplied scalar/UTF-8 representation of a string property. The codec returns .string(text), prepared patch retains it, and AnyHostCanonical uses Data(value.utf8) for string intent/revision identity.
explicitNativeEquivalences: Integral Double versus exactly representable Int64 may match.
A sole $date representation may match the same native millisecond after timezone/fraction normalization.
intendedContract.sourceURL: The mapped property is validated as synced string with xFormat.type=url. The generic Properties edit uses its dynamic owner/property key; the separate URL-open projection does not rewrite that stored edit.

path.meaning: Current exact editable row -> String state -> model.setValue; true dismisses the form.
Raw string codec; prepare then apply; verifiedCurrent accepts snapshot/Undo, clears pending/review, reloads and returns true.
Unchanged requested patch and inverse -> fenced POST -> accepted sequence/readback -> nativeValueMatches -> nativeEquivalent fast synthesized equality -> verifiedCurrent and optional Undo.
Synthesized Equatable includes Swift String canonical equality.

counterexample.kind: Source-derived branch evaluation, not an executed Swift/Native/UI test.
preconditions: Readback fence exactly equals accepted fence and accepted applySequence increases.
Definition bytes remain matching, to demonstrate Undo eligibility.
Only the readback string encoding differs canonically from the requested string.
counterexample.evaluation: nativeEquivalent reaches lhs == rhs and returns true before any raw string code-unit comparison. receipt can mark verifiedCurrent and construct inverse Undo despite the raw mismatch. Presentation trusts that receipt; reloadDocument does not compare the requested property bytes.

existingCoverage.covers: One-property intent/inverse; kind protection; integral numeric and RFC3339 native-equivalence examples. No direct Unicode representation assertion in this inspected file.
Sequence, epoch/identity and value mismatch guards using numeric fixture values. The existing internal receipt/materialize seam can support a meaningful later string regression.
Separate prepared property operation identity/journal/authority source inspected; it does not supply a Unicode receipt regression for this direct Properties route.

smallestLaterCorrectionBoundary.proposal: Use exact UTF-8 comparison for a direct (.string,.string) pair at the property value receipt boundary before falling through to the existing native-equivalence helper. Keep all other value kinds and all authority/fence/definition checks unchanged.
smallestLaterCorrectionBoundary.meaningfulRegression: Through existing prepareSetValue + acceptedFence + materialize + receipt APIs, retain requested raw bytes, reject canonical-equivalent raw-different readback with nativeAcceptedButCurrentStateUnverified/no snapshot/no Undo, and accept the matching raw readback with the original inverse bytes. Cover Name NFC/NFD, Hebrew mark order and the exact mapped URL key. Existing documented numeric/date behavior remains separately preserved.
smallestLaterCorrectionBoundary.nestedContainerStringPolicy: The generic AnyJSON fast path also affects nested strings; that is not required to fix these direct string properties and must not be silently included in a global equality rewrite.
